payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates over all vertex pairs (i,j) in nested loops, prints edges sequentially until required edge count (2n+p) is reached.
payload.rationale: The solution simply enumerates possible edges in a fixed order and outputs the first 2n+p of them. No DFS/BFS or other search strategy is used; the closest match among given subtypes is search_dfs_bfs_graph due to graph context, but it's a poor fit.
